title: carryoverTodos retirement-on-PASS: a committed carryover id that ships deletes its state entry
problem: Residual of carryover-retirement-and-failure-identity (parts b+c landed in PR #439: fingerprint dedupe + lane-scope failure identity). The array still has no removal-on-success path — TTL expiry is the only drain; a PASS cycle that ships a carryover-sourced task leaves the entry in state.CarryoverTodos until its ExpiresAt.
fix: On PASS with committed ids (postship/ApplyCycleOutcome PASS path has them), delete matching CarryoverTodos entries (match by id, and by carryoverActionFingerprint for scout-minted variants). Anchor beside mergeCarryoverTodos (core/failure_learning.go) with a state hook at the PASS closeout.
acceptance: A PASS cycle whose committed id matches a carryover entry removes it; unmatched entries untouched; fingerprint-matched variants also retire; regression test over the PASS closeout seam.
